documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter And Six Months Ended September 30, 2026; And Consider The Declaration Of Interim Dividend, If Any, For The Financial Year 2026-27.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Steel Strips Wheels Limited reported a healthy Q1 FY27 performance with revenue of INR1,509 crores, marking a 27% year-on-year growth. Management highlighted that standalone EBITDA with other income increased by 32% year-on-year to INR165.17 crores, driven by improved operating leverage, favorable product mix, premium products, and input price increases received from OEMs. The company is actively expanding its manufacturing capacities in Bhuj for alloy wheels and aluminum knuckles, alongside brownfield expansion for agricultural and passenger car steel wheels. Looking ahead, management remains optimistic about targeting top-line growth of over 20% and expanding EBITDA per wheel for FY27. Steel Strips Wheels Limited reported its financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, showing strong domestic demand growth alongside a recovery in exports by June as tariff-related disruptions normalized.

guidance.claim: The company targets a top-line growth of 20% plus for FY27.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about our outlook for FY27, targeting a top line growth of 20% plus.

guidance.claim: Management targets enhancing EBITDA per wheel to more than INR310 through the financial year.
guidance.quote: We remain focused on enhancing profitability by increasing our EBITDA per wheel from around INR262 in the previous financial year to more than INR310 through this financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about the medium-term commercial vehicles outlook supported by increased government spending and improving economic activity.
demand_outlook.quote: While industry demand continues to remain uneven across certain categories, we remain optimistic about the medium-term outlook supported by increased government spending and improving economic activity.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for exports has started showing recovery yielding to positive results and improved business momentum.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand for the exports have started showing recovery yielding to positive results and improved business momentum.

demand_outlook.claim: The company sees a tremendous traction for steel wheels in India right after GST cuts.
demand_outlook.quote: But now we see not only is aluminium growing, but also steel has started to grow. And this has happened right after the GST cuts in India.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up two manufacturing facilities in Bhuj including an aluminium wheel plant with an annual capacity of 1.2 million wheels and an aluminium knuckles facility with an annual capacity of 1.1 million units.
capex_expansion.quote: Now as already conveyed, we are setting up two manufacturing facilities in Bhuj. The first is an aluminium wheel plant with an annual capacity of 1.2 million wheels, while the second is an aluminium knuckles facility with an annual capacity of 1.1 million units.

capex_expansion.claim: Trial production at the Bhuj aluminium segment facility is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: We will be at about 6.2 million wheels in the aluminium segment and trial production is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of this current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Total planned capex in the current year for the Bhuj plant and replacement/other plant capex is around INR500 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Total capex, which we are planning in the current year is from the Bhuj plant where we are expanding our alloy wheel capacity by 1.2 million and knuckles capacity 0.6 million. And the total capex in both these are around INR420 crores. And as conveyed in last call, we are also doing some replacement and other plant capex of around INR80 crores. So total capex is around INR500 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is spending about INR150 crores to set up an agricultural wheel capacity expansion line as a brownfield expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: So in line with that, we are going to spend about INR150 crores to set up this line and it's a Brownfield expansion.

capex_expansion.claim: Net capex of INR 196 crores was incurred through FY26 for incremental capacity expansion focused on aluminium wheels and knuckles.
capex_expansion.quote: Net Capex of INR 196 Crs. was incurred through FY26 towards incremental capacity expansion, largely focused on aluminium wheels and aluminium knuckles.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA with other income for the quarter increased by 32% year-on-year and stood at INR165.17 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Standalone EBITDA with other income for the quarter increased by 32% Y-o-Y and stood at INR165.17 crores.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per wheel for the current quarter stands at INR314 per wheel compared to INR262 per wheel in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA per wheel for current quarter stands at INR314 per wheel as compared to INR262 per wheel in the Quarter 1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Margin percentages expanded by 40 bps driven by input increases received from OEMs other than raw materials, operating leverage, a favorable product mix, premium products share, and cost optimization initiatives.
margins_costs.quote: Margin percentages expanded during the quarter by 40 bps, driven by input increases received from OEMs other than raw materials, operating leverage, a favourable product mix and an increasing share of premium products and continued cost optimization initiatives across manufacturing facilities.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew 43% year-on-year to INR71.51 crores with PAT margin improving to 4.7%.
margins_costs.quote: The profit after tax grew 43% Y-o-Y to INR71.51 crores with PAT margin improving to 4.7%.

orders_capacity.claim: All business units are running at more than 95% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: If you really ask me, all my business units are running at more than 95% utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: The aluminum knuckles order book is almost completely sold out.
orders_capacity.quote: And our expansion in Bhuj has become extremely important and necessary. And it's the perfect timing for us because that order book is almost completely sold out.

orders_capacity.claim: Alloy wheel capacity was expanded to 5 million and aluminium knuckles to 5 lacs by 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Alloy Wheels expanded to 5 Mn and Aluminium Knuckles to 5 lacs

orders_capacity.claim: AMW Autocomponent Limited at Bhuj, Gujarat was acquired in 2025.
orders_capacity.quote: Acquisition of AMW Autocomponent Limited at Bhuj, Gujarat

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintained a consistent dividend payout history.
capital_allocation.quote: Consistent Dividend paid by the Company

risks_headwinds.claim: The business faced challenges from the war in West Asia and volatility in commodity prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the war in West Asia and the volatility in commodity prices especially, our business has continued to demonstrate resilience across key segments.

management_commitments.claim: Trial production for the Bhuj aluminium segment facility is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We will be at about 6.2 million wheels in the aluminium segment and trial production is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of this current financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management is targeting a top line growth of 20% plus for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about our outlook for FY27, targeting a top line growth of 20% plus.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to increase EBITDA per wheel from around INR262 in the previous financial year to more than INR310 through this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We remain focused on enhancing profitability by increasing our EBITDA per wheel from around INR262 in the previous financial year to more than INR310 through this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The brownfield expansion for agricultural wheels is targeted to be commercialized before the end of the current calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: I think we are very optimistic to commercialize it before the end of this calendar year, definitely.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
